blockingIssues.description: The new shutdown-state callback path still persists placeholder metadata instead of live in-flight state. workflow/entrypoint.py and multi_account/entrypoint.py now register callbacks, but those callbacks still hardcode the first profile plus progress=0 rather than reporting current runtime progress.

The launcher shutdown path still seeds a static snapshot and never registers a freshness callback, so launcher-driven scrolling runs can still overwrite richer save_state snapshots with stale progress=0 data during shutdown.
blockingIssues.evidence: Review: .factory/validation/reliability/scrutiny/reviews/reliability-scrutiny-fixes-python.json; code: python/runners/launcher.py:113 plus scrolling save_state writers in python/actions/browsing/feed_scrolling/runtime.py:249 and python/actions/browsing/reels_scrolling/runtime.py:210.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When implementing a scrutiny-fix feature, require the worker to reread each prior blocking review finding line-by-line and explicitly confirm how every cited file/path is addressed before declaring the fix complete.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The python rerun updated entrypoints but still missed the previously cited launcher stale-state path, even though the original reliability-python-shutdown review had already called out python/runners/launcher.py as part of the blocker.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify that feature descriptions and expected behavior are binding requirements even when verificationSteps are incomplete; workers should not treat verificationSteps as an exhaustive checklist.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The server fix feature description explicitly required 'VERIFY DEV-SERVER', but the worker skipped it because the listed verificationSteps only mentioned build + Convex tests and still reported followedProcedure=true.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For frontend-only work in repos without frontend tests, require workers to record a justified deviation from red-phase test-first and explain what build, lint, or runtime evidence substituted for tests instead of marking followedProcedure=true with no deviation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The frontend fix review still surfaced the same mismatch between refactor-worker's mandatory red-phase wording and this mission's 'No frontend tests — out of scope' guidance while the handoff claimed full procedure compliance.
